brief.topology: Dedicated VPC and subnet; one Melbourne VM runs Caddy, Alerta API and PostgreSQL in Compose. Only HTTP/HTTPS are public. SSH uses IAP. PostgreSQL data and secret files live on a separate persistent disk; services restart automatically.
brief.resource_rationale: Small single-server deployment suits assumed light traffic and requires few paid resources. Separate retained data disk meets restart durability; Caddy manages HTTPS without a paid load balancer.

heavier_alternatives.why_unnecessary: No multi-server scheduling or scaling requirement was supplied.
PostgreSQL on retained storage meets restart persistence; managed database adds recurring cost.
Caddy on the VM terminates HTTPS for this single hostname.

assumptions: Light initial traffic; a few concurrent users.
Melbourne region proposed; one server is sufficient for this workload.
Operator reserves the administrator account before the public release.
Prices are the historical W2B estimate from 05 Oct 2026; traffic, tax and currency conversion are extra.

pending_decision.action: Approve a deployment tier, create its cloud resources, and release the app publicly only after verification.
targets: Dedicated VPC and subnet in Melbourne
20 GiB boot disk + 20 GiB retained data disk
One static IPv4; HTTP/HTTPS firewall rules; IAP-only SSH
pending_decision.why: One small server fits the expected traffic. Separate persistent storage protects account and alert data across restarts.
pending_decision.cost_or_blast_radius: A: USD 21–30/month. B: USD 35–45/month. Historical W2B estimates; usage and tax extra. Scoped to the new app resources; no changes to existing workloads.
pending_decision.reversibility: Resources can be removed. Elapsed usage charges cannot be refunded; releasing an IP or deleting data can be irreversible.
pending_decision.rollback: Stop the app and remove only resources created for this deployment, with a scoped deletion approval. Retain the data disk unless its deletion is explicitly approved.
pending_decision.success_check: Check HTTPS, signup/login, alert creation and persistence after restart. Record results before public handoff.
